## Intro

This edition covers the week of 23-29 November 2026 and reports developments for commercial road freight in Poland and France, with priority for heavy, oversize and special transport. Reports: Poland: temporary driving-time derogation for domestic LPG tanker transport; Grand Est (France): kilometre-based HGV charge for vehicles over 3.5 t planned from April 2027.

## Lead reports

### Poland: temporary driving-time derogation for domestic LPG tanker transport

According to trade press (e-truckbus.pl), Poland's Minister of Infrastructure has introduced a further temporary derogation from the EU rules on driving time, breaks and rest for drivers carrying liquid petroleum gas (LPG). Drivers can drive up to 11 hours per day under the derogation. Similar derogations were reported for fuel tanker drivers in March.

**Category:** Operational development  
**Where:** Poland, domestic LPG transport only.  
**Affected vehicles:** Tanker vehicles carrying LPG on domestic Polish journeys. The exact vehicle weight thresholds were not stated in the available report.  
**When:** 6 November 2026 to 6 December 2026

**Impact:** Domestic LPG tanker operators in Poland get more scheduling flexibility with up to 11 hours of driving per day. Cross-border LPG journeys are not covered, so planners must separate domestic and international duties. The derogation does not remove the need to record driver activity and to comply with all other rules. This is an industry report, not an official legal text.

**Recommended action:** Check the text of the ministerial regulation before using the extended driving time. Assign it only to purely domestic Polish LPG journeys. Keep international legs on the standard EU driving and rest-time rules. Brief drivers on the end date of 6 December 2026 and on correct tachograph recording, and plan rosters so the derogation is not needed after it expires.

**Exemptions/conditions:** The derogation applies only to domestic LPG transport. Other cargo and cross-border transport are not covered.

*Source: [e-truckbus.pl](https://e-truckbus.pl/czas-jazdy-kierowcow-cystern-lpg-11-godzin/) — Industry report — not an official authority notice*

## Rest of Europe: sourced operational reports

### Grand Est (France): kilometre-based HGV charge for vehicles over 3.5 t planned from April 2027 (France)

According to an Autonews report of 18 November 2026, blue roadside units are appearing in the Grand Est region ahead of a kilometre-based HGV charge, the 'éco-contribution poids lourds' (ECPL). The report puts the rate at 15 cents per kilometre. It says the charge will apply to heavy goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes from April 2027. The Region says the revenue will fund road network financing, maintenance and modernisation.

**Where: Grand Est region, France. The exact road network covered is not specified in the available report. · When: From April 2027 (exact date not supplied)**

**Operator action:** Obtain the official ECPL rules from the Grand Est Region when published: charged roads, categories, exemptions and payment or registration procedure. Add the 15 cent/km figure as a provisional cost in 2027 quotes and review toll or surcharge clauses in long-term contracts.

*Source: [Autonews](https://www.autonews.fr/actualite/nouvelle-taxe-routiere-avec-larrivee-des-boitiers-bleus-voici-les-vehicules-qui-devront-payer-150755) — Industry report — not an official authority notice*

## Operator checklist

- Poland: Check the text of the ministerial regulation before using the extended driving time. Assign it only to purely domestic Polish LPG journeys. Keep international legs on the standard EU driving and rest-time rules. Brief drivers on the end date of 6 December 2026 and on correct tachograph recording, and plan rosters so the derogation is not needed after it expires.
- France: Obtain the official ECPL rules from the Grand Est Region when published: charged roads, categories, exemptions and payment or registration procedure. Add the 15 cent/km figure as a provisional cost in 2027 quotes and review toll or surcharge clauses in long-term contracts.

- [Autonews](https://www.autonews.fr/actualite/nouvelle-taxe-routiere-avec-larrivee-des-boitiers-bleus-voici-les-vehicules-qui-devront-payer-150755)

Friday, 27 November 2026 at 12:00 CET.
